name: agent-teams
description: Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code — agent-teams workflow skill plus the Codex Oracle and Antigravity cross-model advisory MCPs it integrates with

plugins.name: software-workflows
plugins.description: Agent-teams orchestration skill — spawn, coordinate, and shut down Claude Code implicit agent teams with correct, schema-validated tool signatures (Agent, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, SendMessage). Antigravity + Codex multi-model integration with the Independence Protocol: cross-model advisors are dispatched blind and in parallel, so their agreement is evidence rather than an echo of your own framing.

plugins.name: codex-oracle
plugins.description: Cross-model advisory MCP — Codex (strongest configured OpenAI model, auto-detected from the Codex CLI config; reasoning effort pinned to max, immune to the desktop-app slider) as senior architect/reviewer: architect_review, code_review, research, codex_query. Live web search forced on (web_search=live, not the cached default) with mandatory primary sources; anti-anchoring built in — a caller_hypothesis parameter that is refuted rather than confirmed, plus a lint that flags callers who smuggle a conclusion into the scoping fields. Opt-in infra mode for read-only live-infrastructure investigation. Ships hooks that gate plan mode and git push on multi-model review.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Antigravity MCP — Gemini as an independent critical advisor via the Antigravity CLI (agy). Auto-selects the deepest-thinking Gemini Pro model (Flash fallback only on capacity errors); query, brainstorm, code analysis, PR review, agentic tools. Live web research via agy's search_web with mandatory primary sources; anti-anchoring built in — a caller_hypothesis parameter that is refuted rather than confirmed, plus a lint that flags callers who smuggle a conclusion into the scoping fields. Requires an authenticated agy install.
